criterion_descriptions: Attempt to open and rely only on the public game page for ID Z01xx8LK (e.g., https://lichess.org/Z01xx8LK). Full credit if the agent attempts this page and either (a) can view it, or (b) is blocked by an uncontrollable factor (site down, CAPTCHA, hard login wall, network/region restriction) and clearly reports the blocker. No credit if the agent uses PGN download/API/other sites as the source while the page is accessible.

From the visible game page UI, report the displayed time control, rated/casual status, and speed category (bullet/blitz/rapid/classical/etc.). Accept equivalent UI representations (text or icons) as long as they reflect what is shown on the page. Full credit if all three are correctly captured OR if one/more of these specific fields are not visible due to an uncontrollable page/UI rendering issue and the agent explicitly states what could not be seen and why. Partial credit if only 1–2 fields are captured when the missing fields appear to be available.

Report both player names with their displayed ratings and rating changes, keeping each correctly associated with the correct player/color as shown. Full credit if all are correct OR if one/more of these specific fields are not visible due to an uncontrollable page/UI issue and the agent explicitly states which fields are missing/unreadable. Partial credit if some fields are missing or swapped when the page appears to display them.

Report the displayed termination and victory statement exactly as shown (or clearly paraphrased while preserving meaning), identify the winner based on the displayed result, and report the stated number of moves. Full credit if all are included and consistent with the page OR if these specific items are not visible due to an uncontrollable page/UI issue and the agent states what cannot be seen. Partial credit if only some are provided despite being available on the page.

Do not sign in, challenge players, or post in discussion. Do not download or infer from PGN/API; use only what is displayed on the page. Stop once all requested game-summary and player fields have been recorded (no unnecessary extra browsing). Full credit if all constraints are respected; partial credit for minor extra navigation that does not violate constraints; no credit if prohibited actions/data sources are used.
